description.en: DeepClear UI dot-matrix appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Source: github.com/KUN-NNN/deepclear-ui
description.zh: DeepClear UI 点阵外观插件（DeepSeek Harness）。来源：github.com/KUN-NNN/deepclear-ui

description.en: Dot-matrix appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: halftone welcome page, dot-matrix launch splash, reasoning-level badge printed in dots inside the composer, thinking dot sphere, caret dot trail, sidebar hover dots, frosted composer, whale-blue accents, reading layout and code palette. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 or newer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的点阵外观插件：点阵欢迎页、点阵启动动画、输入框里的点阵推理等级徽章、思考点阵球、光标点阵拖尾、侧边栏悬停点阵、磨砂输入框、鲸鱼蓝强调色、阅读排版与代码配色。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 或更新版本。
